idea-plugin.name: BPMN Compare
idea-plugin.description:
Visual comparison of BPMN 2.0 diagrams against any Git revision, powered by bpmn.io (bpmn-js and bpmn-js-differ).
  • Current version of the diagram on the left, a branch, tag or commit of your choice on the right.
  • Added, removed, changed and moved elements are highlighted; a change list lets you jump to each change.
  • Optional synchronization of mouse cursor, hover and pan/zoom between both diagrams.
Open a .bpmn file and switch to the BPMN Diff tab, or use Compare BPMN with Branch or Commit… from the context menu.

The plugin is open source under the MIT license. Diagram rendering and diffing uses bpmn-js (© Camunda Services GmbH, bpmn.io license) and bpmn-js-differ (MIT). Copyright and license notices of all bundled third-party packages are included in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt of the plugin distribution.
